text: Select canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, and exact activity values (type, relation, value, units) for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613797. Source: compound_structures, molecule_dictionary, activities. Join: activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: activities.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613797').
